caption:
सूर्या की फिल्म Scene ने भारत में अपने दूसरे हफ्ते में बॉक्स ऑफिस पर दमदार प्रदर्शन किया है। 🔥
हालांकि दूसरे हफ्ते में फिल्म की कमाई में 65% से ज्यादा की गिरावट दर्ज की गई। 📉
इसके बावजूद यह भारत में सूर्या का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा second week कलेक्शन बन चुका है। 💥
कलेक्शन के मामले में इस फिल्म ने Vishwanath & Sons को भी पीछे छोड़ दिया है। 👍
क्या आपने सूर्या की यह फिल्म थिएटर में देख ली है? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय बताएं! 💬

ctx.title: Scene Box Office Collection Day 14: Scores Suriya’s 2nd Biggest Second Week In India!
ctx.summary:
Suriya's Scene displayed a drop of more than 65% at the Indian box office in its second week, still better than Vishwanath & Sons. 
 The post  Scene Box Office Collection Day 14: Scores Suriya’s 2nd Biggest Second Week In India!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Scene has emerged as a successful affair at the Indian box office, making a hat-trick of money spinners for Suriya. Yesterday, the film wrapped up its second week on a decent-to-good note. Even though it dropped more than expected, the film still pulled off the second-biggest second week of the star. It also became his second film to score 30 crore net or more in the second week. Keep reading for a detailed collection report of day 14!
The Kollywood dark crime comedy earned 1.9 crore on its second Thursday, day 14. Compared to day 13’s 2.65 crore , it showed a 28.3% drop. Including yesterday’s collections, the second week total stands at 35.25 crore , a decline of 68.33% from the opening week’s 111.3 crore . Overall, the film has earned a solid 146.55 crore net at the Indian box office, which equals 172.93 crore gross.
With 35.25 crore, Scene has registered Suriya’s second-biggest second week at the Indian box office. It surpassed Vishwanath & Sons ( 27.55 crore ) to claim the second spot. Karuppu tops the list with 54.3 crore.
Take a look at Suriya’s top second weeks (India net):
So far, only one Suriya film has hit the 150 crore net milestone at the Indian box office: Karuppu. Now, Scene is all set to reach the 150 crore net mark. As of now, it is just 3.45 crore away from reaching the milestone, which will be achieved in the third weekend.
Scene is directed by Aavesham-fame Jithu Madhavan and produced by Suriya, Jyothika, and Jaishree Damodaran under the banner of Zhagaram Studios and 2D Entertainment. It also stars Naslen and Nazriya Nazim in key roles. On BookMyShow, the film has been rated 9 out of 10 with 183K+ votes.
